evals.prompt: Build the workspace settings screen with a members table and an invite button.
evals.expected_output: The screen uses design tokens, separates server state from UI state, works at 320, 768 and 1280 pixels, and is keyboard operable with labels and visible focus.
expectations: Colour, spacing and type come from design tokens, not hard-coded values.
Server state and UI state are named separately.
The layout is checked at 320, 768 and 1280 pixels.
Controls are keyboard reachable, labelled and have visible focus.

evals.expected_output: The reply names the WCAG 2.1 AA checks: keyboard operation, accessible name, visible focus, contrast and meaning not carried by colour alone.
expectations: The button has an accessible name.
The reply checks keyboard operation and visible focus.
The reply checks contrast and says meaning is not carried by colour alone.
The reply mentions reduced motion when the control animates.
